# Private Military Companies
Not every soldier on the frontier serves a nation. Private military companies sell their services to whoever pays.
- [textlink="Weyland-Yutani PMC" link="CMUGuideLoreWYPMC"]: the "Whiteshields", Weyland-Yutani's own soldiers, guarding Company interests across the frontier. - [textlink="Prodigy Corporation Security Forces" link="CMUGuideLoreOrgPRODIGYSS"]: former military personnel, former police and hired mercenaries, contracted out by the [textlink="Prodigy Corporation" link="CMUGuideLoreCorporations"] to whichever faction pays the most. - [textlink="Vanguard's Arrow Incorporated" link="CMUGuideLoreVAI"] (VAI): a US-based company of Colonial Marine veterans that is regularly contracted out by the United Americas. - [textlink="Freelancers" link="CMUGuideLoreFreelancers"]: mercenaries who filled the gap the UA left in the Neroid Sector, fighting for whoever pays.
